digest.component_or_area: mutation gate and test shard configuration
propositions: Recursive conftest glob pattern tests/**/conftest.py in global_support causes all seven mutation shards to be selected for any nested conftest change, wasting runner time.
Pytest loads only selected test directory and its ancestors, not sibling fixture trees; runtime tracing found exactly six conftests across all shards, never seven or unrelated siblings.
Per-shard conftest assignment based on ancestry chain derived from configured test paths eliminates over-triggers without coverage loss and maintains deterministic fail-closed drift detection.

Contract-driven validation derives ancestor conftests from configured test paths, asserts per-shard support closure matches derived set, pins pre-existing non-conftest globals and source/tests mappings, and kills seeded defects.
